# import-map-names

## Plugin reference

- Description: The bare-specifier namespaces only a page's import map answers — a browser host (`@browser-host/`), its worker entry (`@browser-host-worker/`) and its starting snapshot (`@browser-host-snapshot/`), served by web-artifacts: external to every artifact build, never an npm package, never resolved by Bun. And PAGE_SCRIPT_MODULES: the plugin barrels a head script outside the app bundle imports by specifier (the demo prestart), each its own route-chunk entry mapped by the page — every other plugin module is bundled and named by URL. A leaf with no imports directly under framework (not under web-artifacts, whose closure a child would carry into every composition), so source-digest's closure walk — which a server reaches a lazy `import("@browser-host/…")` through — knows them for free.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/demo/shell`
    - `framework/tooling/web-artifacts`
    - `packages/source-digest`
- Core:
  - Exports (values):
    - `BROWSER_HOST_SNAPSHOT_SPECIFIER_PREFIX`
    - `BROWSER_HOST_SPECIFIER_PREFIX`
    - `BROWSER_HOST_WORKER_SPECIFIER_PREFIX`
    - `isBrowserHostSnapshotSpecifier`
    - `isBrowserHostSpecifier`
    - `isImportMapOnlySpecifier`
    - `PAGE_SCRIPT_MODULES`
